title: Bar Drop Mr Blue 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Mr Blue is a complex and intensely fruity blend that layers dark berries with a crisp, cooling edge. The inhale features a rich medley of sweet Blackberry, Blueberry, and Raspberry, providing a robust and juicy berry foundation. This is followed by a sharp, icy finish on the exhale, accompanied by a subtle hint of aniseed that adds depth to the profile. The double-concentrated formulation ensures every note is delivered with remarkable clarity. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is specifically designed for MTL/RDL vaping. When paired with stater vape kits and low-wattage tanks, it produces small vapour clouds alongside exceptional flavour clarity. The even consistency ensures optimal wicking and performance in MTL/RDL devices, providing a smooth and satisfying experience. The Bar Drop Shortfill collection takes the intensely concentrated flavour profiles typically found in "bar salt" ranges and presents them in a 50%-VG format. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there is space to add a single 10ml nicotine shot, allowing you to easily create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. This offers a cost-effective and highly flavoursome solution for sub-ohm vapers.
